subject: Data file not available in the app

messages.author: 0ae9b466510337e5
messages.subject: Data file not available in the app
parts:
Hi,

I'm just starting my adventure with Shiny. I prepared a primitive app to provides two charts derived from publicly-available Scottish Census data. The app is working fine and when I attempt to publish it the RStudio is suggesting the right files but when I attempt to access the app, I get this error message: 
ERROR: object 'oasdta' not found
Naturally, the oasdta is my RDS file that for some reason is not available in the app folder.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Data file not available in the app
parts: I would check to see how you are referencing the loading of that data file and make sure that you have either: "data/oasdta.rds" or "./data/oasdta.rds" as the path in your application.
